beats.say: Forty-five million Indians depend on a strip of land about twenty kilometres wide.
beats.cap: 45 million Indians. One strip 20–22 km wide.

beats.say: The Siliguri Corridor. India's Chicken's Neck.
Nepal on one side. Bangladesh on the other. Bhutan above.
And China's Chumbi Valley points straight at it.
beats.cap: China's Chumbi Valley points straight at it.

beats.say: In twenty seventeen, China tried to extend a road at Doklam, right at that tip.
beats.cap: 2017: China pushes a road into Doklam.

beats.say: India sent in troops. A seventy-three-day standoff.
Why so thin? Nineteen forty-seven. Partition cut East Pakistan, now Bangladesh, out of Bengal.
Every Indian road and railway to the Northeast runs through this gap.
beats.cap: Every road and railway inside India to the Northeast runs through here.

beats.say: That's why India guards this narrow strip so closely.
beats.cap: That's why India guards this narrow strip so closely.
